description: A diagnostic points at exactly what it names, and in a member chain that is the member rather than the receiver the expression begins at: only `padEnd` is throwing, so the caret is on `padEnd` and not on the `s` four clean calls away from it. Two floors in one chain get a caret each rather than stacking at one column, and `flaky.make` is named in full because every step of it is a name while `use` sits behind a call and cannot be. All three member sites are here — reading, writing and updating through a call — and each keeps naming the whole expression while pointing at the member whose accessor runs, since the receiver is what makes `getBox().value` locate anything. The bridge is unmoved by any of it: the offer on `padEnd` still wraps the statement.
